assessments.reasoning: The Internet Archive capture identifies fairlicense.org as the original host and directly shows both paragraphs. The SHA-256 recomputed from all 12,365 UTF-8 bytes matches the envelope and claim. The page supports what the captured project page displays. [Archived Fair page](https://web.archive.org/web/20150926120323id_/http://fairlicense.org/)

The commit-pinned Index decision is primary evidence of the Index's own classification. Its Fair row binds the prospective entity, fair-captured-reference edition, exact HTML digest, and notice locator. The opening declaration assigns the license kind and historical documentary lifecycle to the listed references. The full decision digest matched its capture envelope. [Index decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/software-commons/license-index/22a085fb36b27a74258acc41436fa82277c70d50/docs/decisions/eight-archived-notices-classification.md)

challenge.method: Inspect the archived HTML with scripts inert. Locate the two license paragraphs in the main element, test whether the surrounding commentary changes their documentary scope, and compare the Index row and lifecycle declaration with the full capture.
challenge.results: The main element contains the use condition and disclaimer in separate paragraphs. The copyright placeholder precedes them. The adapted TLDRLegal table and maintainer background are in later sections. The Fair row matches the subject, name, edition, passage, and recomputed full-source digest, and the decision applies historical documentary status to that row.

limitations: The archive establishes the captured publication route. The background gives the maintainer's account of replacing an older reference link. Original authorship, a transfer of authority, and any adoption date remain outside this finding.
The lifecycle applies to the named documentary reference. Other editions, installation, redistribution, and legal effect require separate evidence.
reasoning: The archived project page and the Index decision establish the display and lifecycle propositions in their respective scopes. The lifecycle binding uses the full HTML representation, with the cited notice located inside it.
